text_block_list.text:
A few months ago, a publisher reached out 
with an offer to produce a photo book 
featuring <chrname>, one of the most talked-about 
Umamusume right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After discussing it with <chrname> and getting her 
approval, I had been filming alongside our 
training, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is finally release day. My heart 
pounded with anticipation as I headed to 
the bookstore—
